svg.title: A workflow runs from a CI trigger through a scan and a redacted packet to a person's review; the model and the write job are dashed because you build them.
svg.desc: Moving figure, 11 seconds, looping, no sound. 1. Product label: SUPPLY CHAIN GRAPH · ACTIONS TO A REVIEWED CHANGE. 2. Key: a solid frame means Exists in the repository; a dashed frame means Yours to build. 3. Process, 10 steps: 1. Caller workflow (dispatch or PR, read-only), trigger, lane YOUR CI, READ-ONLY; 2. Scan and evaluate (freshness, coverage, IDs), action, lane YOUR CI, READ-ONLY; 3. Redacted packet (carries package names), action, lane YOUR CI, READ-ONLY; 4. Job summary (aggregate counts only), end, lane YOUR CI, READ-ONLY; 5. Webhook example (off unless configured), end, lane YOUR CI, READ-ONLY; 6. Your model (none called by default), ai, lane YOURS TO BUILD, proposed, not built yet; 7. Proposal check (only packet evidence), action, lane YOUR CI, READ-ONLY; 8. Human review (bound to hash and commit), human-gate, lane A PERSON; 9. Write job (branch or PR, narrow token), action, lane YOURS TO BUILD, proposed, not built yet; 10. Test and re-scan (evaluate --previous), end, lane YOUR CI, READ-ONLY. Links: Caller workflow to Scan and evaluate; Scan and evaluate to Job summary; Scan and evaluate to Redacted packet; Redacted packet to Webhook example, conditional, labelled if set; Redacted packet to Your model; Your model to Proposal check; Proposal check to Human review; Human review to Write job; Write job to Test and re-scan. 4. Status line: Your own repository's CI scans only its own checkout. 5. Caller workflow runs. 6. Scan and evaluate runs. 7. Job summary runs. 8. Redacted packet runs. 9. Status line: Raw results stay private; the job summary holds counts only. 10. Status line: Packets carry package names, so decide before they leave. 11. Proposal check runs. 12. Status line: A proposal may cite only what the packet contains. 13. Human review runs. 14. Status line: Approval holds for one proposal hash at one source commit. 15. Test and re-scan runs. 16. Status line: A suggestion is not a fix: a fresh scan shows what changed. 17. Every step returns to waiting.

g.text: SUPPLY CHAIN GRAPH · ACTIONS TO A REVIEWED CHANGE
Your own repository's CI scans only its own checkout
Raw results stay private; the job summary holds counts only
Packets carry package names, so decide before they leave
A proposal may cite only what the packet contains
Approval holds for one proposal hash at one source commit
A suggestion is not a fix: a fresh scan shows what changed
